prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image1 is the canonical FRONT of this exact product. Create ONE alternate rear studio photo of THIS SAME OBJECT by rotating camera only. Design specification: counter display stand with one high smooth bag hook on a sturdy bamboo column and woven base; front has an empty low basket, right side the curved hook, rear cross brace. CAMERA exact REAR ELEVATION, 180-degree orbit from canonical front, front-facing features hidden on opposite side, level with product center, not oblique or overhead. Keep reference width/depth/height, shape, color, regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions weave, deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain finish, exact count/positions of all rods, cones, cradles, clamps, holes, hooks, trays, panels, feet, hinges, ribs, padding and secondary materials. Reference image determines actual visible design. Reveal hidden structures coherently; do not add/redesign parts. Match scale, placement, warm-white seamless background, soft light/subtle shadow. Entire product centered with margins, sharp fiber texture, square. Empty product, no actual jewelry/accessories, props, people, animals, room, plants, food or detached extras. No mirror-flip substitute, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, numbers, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, symbols, inscriptions or measurements anywhere.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
